name: Izin Tinggal Tetap (KITAP)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 consecutive years holding a KITAS (limited stay permit) before converting to KITAP (permanent stay permit). Some categories -- spouses/children of Indonesian citizens, former Indonesian citizens, and certain investors -- may qualify via alternative, less-clearly-specified paths.
requirements.fix_path: Hold KITAS status continuously for 5 years.

evidence_required.document: Sponsor/employer or spousal documentation, depending on prior KITAS category

outcome.duration_length: permanent, but the physical card must be renewed every 5 years

sources.title: GoLaw -- KITAS/KITAP guide: 5-year consecutive KITAS requirement, permanent status with 5-year card renewal

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Indonesia's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: imigrasi.go.id's own KITAP FAQ page (imigrasi.go.id/faq/izin-tinggal/apa-saja-syarat-pengajuan-izin-tinggal-tetap) returned an HTTP 403 in this pass, so this route is tier-3 sourced only. work_rights set 'restricted': KITAP holders generally still cannot freely take any job -- specific work authorisation depends on the underlying basis for the permit, consistent with Indonesia's broader pattern of tying employment rights to a specific sponsor/role rather than granting open work rights on residence status alone; this is an inference from the pattern seen across id_work_kitas and id_marriage_kitas rather than a directly confirmed KITAP-specific rule, flagged accordingly. required_prior_route_ids lists this dataset's KITAS-type routes that plausibly feed into the 5-year conversion; the source also mentions unspecified 'alternative eligibility paths' for spouses/children of citizens and certain investors, which were not independently detailed or separately modelled.
